answer: Each agent identity must accumulate age-weighted proof-of-work before earning, where every verified action references a prior work vertex, forming a chain whose inlet is the genesis attestation and whose cumulative difficulty grows like a comet tail—longer and costlier with time. A sybil farm must pay full compute to age each fake identity independently before it can bid or vote, so launching N credible identities costs N times the aging work rather than one shared bond, making mass identity creation economically irrational while honest agents amortize cost over a single long-lived identity.
